description:
Fan-made NieR:Automata style desktop terminal. Not affiliated with Square Enix.

NEW (25/11/2026): CALENDAR, WEEKLY SCHEDULE AND MUSIC CONTROLS
Thanks for the ideas in the comments.
- QUESTS > CALENDAR: a full month calendar for birthdays, appointments and reminders. Click a day, then NEW ENTRY (or double-click the day). Type the title on the on-screen keyboard (or your real keyboard with YoRHa Helper, below) or pick a suggestion, then set the time or all day, a repeat (weekly, monthly, yearly) and an alert (at the time, 10 min, 1 hour or 1 day before). Alerts appear above the hub panel with a soft chime and stay until you acknowledge or snooze them; alerts missed while the PC was off show up when you come back (up to 12 hours).
- QUESTS > WEEKLY SCHEDULE: plan your week as a timetable. Click an empty slot to add an activity, choose its days, start and end time, and an optional alert when it starts. A line marks the current time in today's column.
- Desktop agenda: this week, what is on now, what is next and your coming entries, above the hub panel and never over your character. 'Desktop agenda' in the properties or SYSTEM > QUICK SETTINGS: when something is planned (default), always, or hidden.
- YoRHa Helper (optional, free): Wallpaper Engine lets wallpapers see what is playing but not control it, and sends them no key presses. Step-by-step setup is inside the wallpaper under SYSTEM > YORHA HELPER: open github.com/CalebFrums/yorha-terminal, click Download YoRHaHelper.zip, unzip it, double-click Install-YoRHaHelper.cmd once, then switch on 'YoRHa Helper' in the properties or SYSTEM > QUICK SETTINGS (it is off by default, and the wallpaper never contacts the helper while it is off). You get working music buttons in INTEL (previous, play/pause, next; they press the Windows media keys, so Spotify, browsers and most players respond) and TYPE ON PC KEYBOARD in the calendar and schedule editors: a small text box where you type with your real keyboard, Chinese, Japanese and Korean input included. Without it, use the on-screen keyboard ('On-screen keyboard': shown when the helper is off, always, or hidden).
- Prefer the properties? 'Calendar entries as text' and 'Weekly schedule as text' take entries like 2026-12-03 18:30 Dentist | 12-25 Christmas, and Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 Work | Tue,Thu 19:00-20:30 Gym.
- Privacy: your entries stay on your PC. Nothing is sent to any server or to me; YoRHa Helper only talks to the wallpaper on your own PC (127.0.0.1), never connects to the internet and keeps no log.

UPDATE (21/11/2026): UNIT, WELLNESS AND AUDIO SENSITIVITY
- UNIT: look after your character, Tamagotchi style. Integrity, energy and morale drift down in real time. Repair with recovery items, put the unit in sleep mode, pat it, and give it Lunar Tears grown in the GARDEN. Care builds bond, which unlocks accessories from the game (Pink Ribbon, Blue Ribbon, Lunar Tear, Fox Mask, Machine Head, Emil's Head); they show on the desktop too. UNIT > WARDROBE also switches your unit between its outfits, any character images that share its name, such as 2B's Reincarnation render. Pick your unit in ARCHIVE > SET AS UNIT. Nothing is ever lost: an empty meter only means a tired or sulking unit. Do not feed it mackerel.
- QUESTS > WELLNESS: optional reminders to rest your eyes (20-20-20 rule), drink water, stretch, check your posture and eat at your meal times. The Pod proposes them on a small card: DONE, LATER, or a 20-second eye-rest countdown. Switch them on in the properties or in QUESTS > WELLNESS, and click an interval to change it. Reminders appear while the desktop is in view. Looking after yourself also rewards your unit.
- Audio sensitivity slider (25 to 800%) and Auto-boost for quiet audio (on by default), so calm, quiet music moves the visualizer, the particles and the character. Both are also in SYSTEM > QUICK SETTINGS.

LANGUAGES
English, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어, Русский, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português (Brasil). 'Language' starts on Auto, which follows the language Wallpaper Engine reports and falls back to English. Pick one in the properties or in SYSTEM > QUICK SETTINGS.

HUB AND PLACES
The desktop is the hub. Hover a menu entry to preview it, click to go there; HUB brings you back, or the terminal returns on its own when idle.
- MAP: drag the globe, click locations to survey them
- QUESTS: time progress, your own daily orders checklist, calendar with alerts, weekly schedule, focus timer, wellness reminders
- INTEL: now playing with music controls, audio log, Pod archive
- ARCHIVE: character grid; click a record to select it, then deploy it to the desktop or set it as your unit (double-click deploys straight away)
- UNIT: care for your character, bond, outfits, accessories and supplies
- HACKING: BREACH, a 3D intrusion drill (fly the probe with the cursor, break the shield nodes, destroy every core), the 2D drills INTERCEPT (click packets before they reach the core) and LOGIC LOCK (rotate tiles until every terminal is powered), and your records
- GARDEN: plant Lunar Tears, stir the wind with the cursor
- SYSTEM: diagnostics and quick settings you can change from the desktop

FEATURES
- Live clock and date in the YoRHa menu style
- Audio visualizer with adjustable sensitivity, Pod log with time-aware messages, floating particles, scanlines and glitches
- Daylight, night or automatic theme (switches by the clock; set the hours in the properties)
- Menu on the left or right, works on ultrawide and portrait monitors
- Your own image or .webm video as a duotone background

CHARACTERS
A character set is included and appears right away. To use your own, set 'Character folder' to a folder of PNG renders. The file name is the name on screen: '01 - 2B - YoRHa No.2 Type B.png' shows 2B with the subtitle; the leading number only sets the order. Tall transparent PNGs (600 px high or more) stand beside the panel, breathe, emote, say your custom lines and react to clicks; other images stay in ARCHIVE. Click a record in ARCHIVE > CHARACTERS to keep it on the desktop. Images with the same name as your unit ('2B - Revealing Outfit.png') become outfits in UNIT > WARDROBE.

PRIVACY
INTEL > AUDIO LOG lists what Media Integration picks up, browser videos included. Clear it with INTEL > CLEAR AUDIO LOG, and choose Keep, Music only, This session only or Off under 'Audio log' (also in SYSTEM > QUICK SETTINGS).

TIPS
- Turn on Media Integration in Wallpaper Engine's settings for the INTEL panel; run YoRHa Helper for the music buttons and keyboard typing
- Allow mouse input for menu hover, character reactions and the UNIT and WELLNESS buttons
- Quiet music barely moving the bars? Raise 'Audio sensitivity' or keep 'Auto-boost quiet audio' on

audiogain.text: Audio sensitivity (%) - raise it for quiet music

options.label: Keep music only (skip videos the player reports, e.g. YouTube)

autocycle.text: Auto-switch panel every N seconds (0 = off)

calendarentries.text: Calendar entries as text: 2026-12-03 18:30 Dentist | 12-25 Christmas (no year = every year)

calwidget.text: Desktop agenda above the hub panel (calendar + weekly schedule)

charfolder.text: Character folder (empty = included set; PNG renders, file name = character name)

dailyorders.value: Drink some water|Stretch for five minutes|Back up your save data|Finish one task you have been avoiding

emotefreq.text: Emote frequency (0 = only react to clicks)

emotelines.value: Glory to Mankind.|...|Hm.|Systems nominal.|Is something wrong?|Proceeding with the mission.

eyesevery.text: Eye break every N minutes (0 = off)

hubreturn.text: Return to the hub after N seconds idle (0 = never)

options.label: Menu on the right (keeps desktop icons clear)

mealtimes.text: Meal reminder times, 24 h (separate with |, empty = off)

onscreenkeyboard.text: On-screen keyboard for calendar and schedule titles

postureevery.text: Posture check every N minutes (0 = off)

scheduleentries.text: Weekly schedule as text: Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 Work | Tue,Thu 19:00 Gym

stretchevery.text: Stretch break every N minutes (0 = off)

options.label: Auto (day and night by the clock)

waterevery.text: Drink water every N minutes (0 = off)

yorhahelper.text: Use YoRHa Helper (off by default): music buttons and PC keyboard typing through a separate program you download and run yourself. This PC only, no logs. Setup steps: SYSTEM > YORHA HELPER.

title: YoRHa Terminal - NieR:Automata UI
